notes:
Summary: SMB helpdesk/SaaS vendor building an in-app smart FAQ and auto-drafting replies. Came in via self-serve trial. Low-engagement pattern: first key issued, minimal calls (embeddings only), then switched to competitor promo. CPO says: "we need predictable per-conversation cost + easy integration".

On the call (2026-02-20):
- Needs: fast embeddings for KB (~200ms target), ephemeral chat generation for agent suggestions (P95 < 700ms), cost cap per-conversation, simple SDK.
- Security: SOC2 preferred, needs audit logs, but no strict residency or VPC requirement now.
- Priority: speed to market over perfect accuracy; cost sensitivity high.
- Quote: "If we can show 30% lower per-convo cost vs our current setup, we'll move back."

Why at-risk:
- No production traffic after initial key — only 3 embed API calls (proof-of-concept).
- Customer used an OpenAI promotional credit in Feb which covered prototype work. They signaled budget uncertainty for April.
- Trial expired without a usage touchpoint. Billing/packaging confusion: unclear difference between token tiers and embeddings pricing in initial welcome email.

AE notes / actions so far:
- Sent pricing breakdown + embeddings vs chat cost examples (2026-02-22).
- Offered a 30-day trial extension with usage credits (email 2026-02-28) — no reply.
- Logged RED-4321 asking docs team to add clearer embeddings pricing snippet into welcome flow.

Suggested playbook to recover:
- Quick 20-min demo focused on cost math (showing batching, caching, and prefix caching wins for KB workloads).
- Offer limited-time credits to re-run prototype (embeddings + 5K tokens generation).
- SE to help instrument simple streaming example; show P95 latency on hosted_api region us-west.
- Ask for a 2-week pilot goal: 1000 embed ops + 100 agent suggestions to validate latency and cost.

Common objections expected: 
- "We're already on OpenAI credits" — counter with predictable pricing scenarios and dedicated caching benefits.
- "Switching infra is more work" — offer a migration checklist + small SE-led PoC.
